title: Camelot Actor
description: v1.2 principal identity (operator, knight, node, provider, or service). Shared fragment embedded via $ref into task, task-dag, memory-retrieval-lease, context-packet, evidence-envelope, and symbolect-tree schemas; the receipt schema carries an inline equivalent. Actors are identified by an immutable id plus a role and node binding; trust context is carried by the surrounding envelope (receipt.actor, lease.subject, decision.actor). The fragment has no schema_version of its own (versioned at catalog level as camelot-actor/1) so embedded actors stay consistent with the inline receipt actor shape. See Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2 §11 and §19.2.

node_trust_band.description: Trust band of the node under which this actor acted (v1.2).

persona_class.description: Knight persona class when the actor is a compiled persona (§16).

operator_id.description: Human operator identity when the actor is a person; paired with a tenant-scoped role.
